title: Toddlers Opening Presents by Christmas Tree, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful mid-century black-and-white snapshot depicting Christmas morning in an American home. A young girl dressed in a puffy white dress with a hair ribbon stands near a cylindrical canister, while a toddler boy in a knit sweater crouches on the floor, excitedly playing with pieces from a freshly opened gift. In the background stands a Christmas tree heavily draped in shiny tinsel garlands, surrounded by stacks of patterned gift boxes and mid-century furniture.
